name: ActionRow
description: A reviewable Relay action proposal attached to document context.

target.description: Target entity, event, note, task, or unresolved target reference.

destination.description: Optional destination surface or collection for the action.

confidence.description: Agent confidence from 0.0 to 1.0 when applicable.

evidence.description: Block or source ids that ground the proposal.

validation: action must resolve to a host Relay.Action.Registry id before execution
review must be draft or ready for agent-created blocks
accepted and rejected states may only be produced by host review flows
evidence refs should resolve to known blocks or source manifest entries when present
visibility must be allowed by the current document and user scope
